A plumb line is suspended from a ceiling of a car moving with horizontal acceleration $a$. What will be the angle of inclination with vertical?
solution:
When the car moves towards right with acceleration $a$, due to pseudo force the plumb line tilts backward, making an angle $\theta$ with vertical. From the figure

$\tan\theta = \dfrac{a}{g} \quad \therefore \theta = \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{a}{g}\right)$

stem: The activity of a radioactive material is $2.56 \times 10^{-3}$ Ci. If the half life of the material is $5$ days, after how many days the activity will become $2 \times 10^{-5}$ Ci?
solution:
$\dfrac{A}{A_0} = \dfrac{2\times10^{-5}}{2.56\times10^{-3}} = \dfrac{1}{128} = \left(\dfrac12\right)^7$

After 7 half lives the activity comes down to the given value: $T = 7\times5 = 35$ days

stem:
What will be the difference between electromagnetic radiation shown in A and B respectively ?

(i) Velocity (ii) Wavelength (iii) Frequency (iv) Energy
solution: EM waves shown in figure A have higher wavelength in comparison to waves shown in figure B. Thus these waves also differ in frequency and energy: $\nu = \dfrac{c}{\lambda}$, $E = \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$. Velocity is the same.
